name: agent-browser
description: Give an agent eyes + hands on the web through the agent-browser CLI: inspect pages, take screenshots, extract content (including from pages behind a login), and drive forms. Use for visual inspection, rendered-page extraction, auth-gated content, form filling, or deployed-UI checks. Reads are free; most writes run immediately, so get human approval before every write. confirmActions matches exact protocol names: upload/download hold, eval does NOT hold JavaScript evaluation because its protocol name is evaluate. Honour whatever config the project points the CLI at and never widen it — allowedDomains and saved-state replay cannot coexist, and dropping the allowlist to get replay is the human's call. Needs the agent-browser CLI (npm i -g agent-browser) and host Chrome/Chromium.
